Bringing the World Together.
Your Expo. Your Interests. Your Journey.

Meet ATHAR, your AI-powered companion for Expo 2030 Riyadh. Whether you have a few hours or a full day, ATHAR will craft a personalized journey around your interests, connect you with experiences worth discovering, and adapt your itinerary in real time as your day unfolds.

Discover more. Experience more. Make every moment count.

Events and food

What to see, and where to eat.

Browse 1 Oct to 31 Dec 2030 events and food places, then add what you want to your plan. Crowd levels (Empty, Moderate, Crowded) are simulated, and busier places add queue time to your plan. Venues and programming are illustrative, not official Expo 2030 information.
